name: Peer Pressure
overview: Scripture warns believers to resist the enticement of sinners and avoid walking in the path of the wicked, emphasizing the importance of choosing wise companions to preserve one's soul. The desire to please others, as seen in Pilate's decision to release Barabbas and condemn Jesus, illustrates the danger of yielding to peer pressure at the expense of righteousness. Instead, Christians are called to obey God rather than men, recognizing that no worldly gain justifies the loss of one's soul.
